description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant counts across different relevance criteria. The horizontal axis represents the “Number of Participants” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The vertical axis lists the “Criterion” categories: “Relevant FCs”, “FC Summary”, “Relevance Explanation”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “Overall Summary”, “Filters”, and “Veracity Explanation”, listed in that order from top to bottom. Each criterion is represented by a single bar, all of which are the same shade of dark green. The bar for “Relevant FCs” extends to a value of approximately 6, while the bar for “FC Summary” extends to a value of 5. The bars for “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” both reach a value of 3. “Overall Summary” is represented by a bar extending to 2, and both “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” have bars reaching a value of 1. The bars are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and are arranged in descending order based on the number of participants.
